digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge status and canary health
propositions: Consolidate duplicate pass-record producers into one process-finalizer writer that records minimal authoritative JSON to refs/reconciler/last-pass before releasing refs/reconciler/lock using observed-OID CAS with exactly three attempts and exponential backoff.

Implement unified status contract with total precedence PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY, where canonical bridge status and hidden bridge-status alias are identical read-only non-mutating entrypoints sharing parser and core.

Derive stable local:<repo-env-id> identity from .env-id for writer and status, treating missing or unreadable .env-id as hard configuration error; preserve legacy JIRA env and inbound event metadata unchanged.

Canary transitions from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable last-pass status by fetching refs/reconciler/* and performing two read-only snapshots to detect stalled fence as CRASHED while respecting observed lease_secs up to 480-second hard limit.
Status detail safely degrades when absent or mismatched by reading one rolling detail file; match verdict only when pass and environment ids agree with authoritative ref.

Remove duplicate producers and dead baseline fields after semantic and string reference sweeps; regenerate byte-exact CLI help, env-vars, ADR index, and ADR 0094 documentation extending ADR 0031 precedent.
